public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This environment is a centralized, stateful appointment scheduling platform used by blood donation organizations.  
It maintains a real-time record of locations, available time slots, registered users and their appointment histories, ensuring slots are allocated efficiently without conflict.  
Users interact with the system to book, modify, and cancel appointments, while staff use it to coordinate donor visits and resource allocation—making it a natural fit for arranging specific donation times at particular locations.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- No user can book more than one appointment for the same time slot.
- A time slot cannot be double-booked for the same location.
- Only available time slots can be booked.
- Appointment status must be updated on cancellation or completion.
public_context.task:
Perform the following schedule cleanup and reallocation actions:

1) Cancel Eva Rivera’s appointment at Central City Blood Center (location_id: LOC1) in time slot TS-2022-02 because she is ineligible, and set TS-2022-02 to available afterward.

2) Reschedule Priya Mistry’s appointment from Lakeside Regional Blood Bank (location_id: LOC3, time slot TS-2024-05) to Green Valley Donation Clinic (location_id: LOC2) on 2023-11-21 at 14:00 (time slot TS-2023-15). Ensure the destination slot is not double-booked, update her appointment to the new location and time slot, then mark the original slot TS-2024-05 as available.

3) Since Samuel Wong’s appointment at Green Valley (TS-2023-10) is canceled, update TS-2023-10 to be available.

4) Correct Hilltop Health Center’s time slot TS-2024-09 to be unavailable because it is already scheduled for John Joice, to prevent double-booking.

function.description:
Retrieve details for locations matching a given name and optionally city.

Args:
    name (str): The name of the location (case-insensitive exact match).
    city (str, optional): City name for additional filter (case-insensitive substring match in address).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[LocationInfo],  # Matching locations (may be empty)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of input error
    }

Constraints:
    - Name must be provided as a non-empty string.
    - City filter is optional; if given, is checked as substring in address field.
function.name: get_location_by_name

function.description:
List all registered blood donation locations.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[LocationInfo],  # List of all registered locations (may be empty if none exist)
    }
function.name: list_locations

function.description:
Retrieve all time slots for a given location and date.

Args:
    location_id (str): ID of the location to search.
    date (str): Target date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[TimeSlotInfo]  # May be empty,
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str,  # Reason for failure (invalid location or date format)
    }

Constraints:
    - location_id must exist in the system.
    - date must be in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
    - Only slots whose start_time begins with date are included.
function.name: get_timeslots_by_location_and_date

function.description:
Retrieve available time slots for a given location on a specified date.

Args:
    location_id (str): The ID of the location to filter.
    date (str): The date to filter timeslots ('YYYY-MM-DD').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[TimeSlotInfo],  # All matching available timeslots
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g., invalid location
    }

Constraints:
    - Only include timeslots for the given location_id.
    - Only where is_available == True.
    - Only where start_time (and/or end_time) falls on the given date.
    - Location must exist.
function.name: get_available_timeslots

function.description:
Retrieve full details of a single timeslot given by timeslot_id.

Args:
    timeslot_id (str): Unique identifier for the desired time slot.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": TimeSlotInfo  # The returned time slot's details
            }
        - On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # "Timeslot not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - timeslot_id must exist in the system.
function.name: get_timeslot_by_id

function.description:
Retrieve user information by name.

Args:
    name (str): The user's full name to search for.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": List[UserInfo]
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Explanation of the error (e.g., no user found or invalid input)
        }

Constraints:
    - Returns all users matching the name (case-sensitive).
    - If no user matches, returns error.
    - If name is None or empty, returns error.
function.name: get_user_by_name

function.description:
Retrieve user information by user_id.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique identifier for the user.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": UserInfo} where UserInfo contains the user's details.
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "User not found"}

Constraints:
    - user_id must exist in the system.
function.name: get_user_by_id

function.description:
List all appointments for a user (by user_id), for conflict or history checks.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user's unique ID.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[AppointmentInfo],    # appointments for this user
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str   # e.g. "User does not exist"
    }

Constraints:
    - The user must exist in the system.
function.name: get_user_appointments

function.description:
Retrieve all appointments booked for a specific location and time slot.

Args:
    location_id (str): The venue identifier to check.
    timeslot_id (str): The time slot identifier to check.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": List[AppointmentInfo],  # List of appointment dicts (possibly empty)
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g., unknown location/timeslot)
        }

Constraints:
    - location_id must exist in the system.
    - timeslot_id must exist in the system.
function.name: get_appointments_by_timeslot_and_location

function.description:
Retrieve complete details of an appointment by its ID.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): Unique identifier for the appointment to be queried.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": AppointmentInfo,
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Appointment not found"
            }
Constraints:
    - Appointment ID must exist in the system.
function.name: get_appointment_by_id

function.description:
Check if the user (by user_id) is eligible to donate.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique identifier of the user.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True if user found, with donor_status info, else False and error reason.
        data: { "user_id": str, "donor_status": str } if successful.
        error: str if user not found.

Constraints:
    - The user must exist in the system.
function.name: check_user_donor_status

function.description:
Book a new appointment for a user at a given location and available time slot.

Args:
    user_id (str): Registered user ID (donor)
    location_id (str): Location for donation appointment
    timeslot_id (str): Chosen available timeslot

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Appointment booked successfully",
            "appointment_id": str
        }
        On failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason for failure
        }

Constraints:
    - The user, location, and timeslot must exist.
    - Only available time slots can be booked.
    - No user can book more than one appointment for the same time slot.
    - A time slot cannot be double-booked for the same location.
    - On success the timeslot's availability must be updated.
function.name: create_appointment

function.description:
Update the status of an existing appointment to "canceled".

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to be canceled.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Appointment <appointment_id> has been canceled."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g. appointment not found or already not cancelable)
    }

Constraints:
    - Appointment must exist.
    - Appointment must not already be canceled or completed.
function.name: cancel_appointment

function.description:
Update the status of the appointment to "completed" after donation.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment to be completed.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Appointment marked as completed." }
        - On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Appointment must exist.
    - Only "scheduled" appointments can be marked as completed.
    - "canceled" or already "completed" appointments cannot be completed.
function.name: complete_appointment

function.description:
Change the status of an appointment ('scheduled', 'canceled', 'completed').

Args:
    appointment_id (str): Unique ID of the appointment to update.
    new_status (str): The new status ('scheduled', 'canceled', or 'completed').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Status updated to <new_status> for appointment <appointment_id>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <reason string>
    }

Constraints:
    - appointment_id must exist in the system.
    - new_status must be one of 'scheduled', 'canceled', 'completed'.
function.name: update_appointment_status

function.description:
Set the availability of a specified time slot.

Args:
    timeslot_id (str): Unique identifier of the time slot.
    is_available (bool): Desired availability status (True for available, False for unavailable).

Returns:
    dict: {
        'success': True,
        'message': 'Timeslot availability updated.'
    }
    or
    {
        'success': False,
        'error': 'Time slot not found.'
    }

Constraints:
    - The timeslot_id must exist in the system (self.timeslots).
    - No other state modifications are performed, only is_available field update.
function.name: update_timeslot_availability

function.description:
Change location, time slot, or user info for an existing appointment (reschedule).

Args:
    appointment_id (str): ID of the appointment to modify.
    new_user_id (str, optional): New user ID for the appointment.
    new_location_id (str, optional): New location ID for the appointment.
    new_timeslot_id (str, optional): New timeslot ID for the appointment.
        At least one of new_user_id, new_location_id, or new_timeslot_id must be provided.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True, "message": "Appointment modified successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False, "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - No user can have more than one appointment for the same timeslot.
    - A timeslot cannot be double-booked for the same location.
    - Only available timeslots can be booked.
    - Status must not be canceled or completed.
function.name: modify_appointment_details
